restorative justice is a promising and effective practice for the criminal justice system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
restorative justice in Australia is still in its infancy, with a limited range of programs in existence and limited research into their effectiveness.

the Australian criminal justice response to crime has become a complex and multifaceted system that includes a range of formal responses to crime, as well as a range of non traditional or restorative justice responses.
restorative justice is not a panacea but rather an important tool in the criminal justice system that can be used to address the needs of victims and offenders.

restorative justice programs continue to be used across Australia but are not being used in the same way or for the same purpose as they were 15 years ago.
